6.2.3.2.4 Memory Abstraction Interface
Detection Reported by the Flash Eeprom Emulation (see Flash Eeprom emulation above), only if the stack is configured in polling mode Reaction N/A Report Depending on the configuration:
• The error shall be polled by the NVRAM manager with the function MemIf_GetJobResult (job result set to MEMIF_JOB_FAILED) [MemIf043] [MemIf053]. Recovery See NVRAM Manager.
caption: 6.2.3.2.4 Memory Abstraction Interface

targets.why: polling error via MemIf_GetJobResult returning MEMIF_JOB_FAILED
